feature_1_bulk_management.details: Checkbox column present, select-all working, bulk bar with count and 6 action buttons (activate, deactivate, tupo, tupo-clear, delete, clear). Tested bulk deactivate/activate on 2 members, bulk delete on 2 members, correctly rejects deletion of member with downline. Own row shows 'Anda' instead of checkbox.

feature_2_network_tree_redesign.details: Mobile-style vertical tree with [+]/[-] toggles, avatar placeholder, name, member_id, APPV with 2 decimals, rank badge, membership badge, flame icon, frontline chip, metrics line 'PPV x / KG x / AKG x / TNPV x / ATNPV x'. Node detail panel shows KU, KG, AKU, AKG. Org Structure tab shows hierarchy with totals and expandable provinces/stokis/members.

feature_3_manual_tupo.details: Admin can mark Tupo manually via bulk bar or single-row flame icon. POST /api/tupo with ok=true marks tupo_manual=true, tupo_ok=true WITHOUT adding any transaction (verified transaction count unchanged). GET /api/tupo returns override list. Clear operation removes manual marking. Flame icon shows 'M' marker for manual tupo.

feature_4_region_dropdowns.details: GET /api/regions returns 38 provinces and 514 cities. Province select in Add Member dialog populates city select (e.g., Jawa Barat -> 27 cities including Kota Bandung). Both selects working in Add Member and Edit Member dialogs. No free typing, only dropdown selection.

feature_5_hierarchy_correction.details: GET /api/hierarchy returns correct structure: Admin Pusat (1) > Admin Provinsi (4) > Stokis (4) > Member (5). Stokis cannot delete members (403), cannot see other stokis' members (scope_query working), cannot access Tutup Buku or Pengaturan menus. Admin Provinsi oversees stokis in their province.

feature_6_payout_page.details: New /payout page shows omset detail, bonus paid, payout %, company %. Range info displays label, dates, month/year, periods, transaction count. KPI cards for omset, bonus, payout %, company %. Payout % + company % + stokis fee % = 100% (verified). Tables for bonus per jenis (7 types), per periode, per produk, top earners. CSV export working.

feature_7_edit_names.details: Admin can edit own name via PUT /api/me (settings-my-name field). Admin can edit company name and tagline (settings-company, settings-company-tagline). Sidebar updates after changes. Current values verified: company='Hybrid MLM', admin='Admin Pusat'.

feature_8_date_filters.details: PeriodFilter component with 3 modes: period (default), month (shows 'Agustus 2026 (1 bulan penuh)' covering P1+P2), year (shows 'Tahun 2026 (1 tahun penuh)' covering 24 periods). GET /api/payout?mode=period|month|year working. No console errors when switching modes. Also working on /bonus and /transactions pages.
